verdicts.proof: The failure logic is shared. paid_change_banner.dart:63-77 picks the failed entry and builds ack (PaidChangeQueue.acknowledge). Only _box at :127-131 branches on MgV2 and draws MgStateBanner(tone err) with the same title and text from paidChangeFailureTitle/paidChangeFailureText (:89-93). The non-taken case gets MgBtnText 'pdUnderstood' -> ack (:85). There is only one entry point: PaidChangeBanner is used only in res_detail_tab_content.dart:87. The v2 detail (res_detail_view_v2.dart:97) renders that same ResDetailTabContent. The banner file is new on this branch (absent in 70a94933), so the old look here means the kill-switch-off branch of the same file.

offerOther = failed.isSwap && isTakenReason(reason) (:72) is shared. v2Actions (:80-84) wire MgBtnInk 'pdKeepCurrentMoto' to ack and MgBtnGhostLight 'pdPickOtherMoto' to pickOther. pickOther acknowledges and then pushes swapPickRoute = '/reservations/<id>/edit?tab=swap' (paid_change_outcomes.dart:41). The edit screen state (reservation_edit_screen.dart:200-203, _wantTab=='swap') is shared by both looks, so the swap tab opens in v2 as well. The title 'pdTakenTitle' comes from paidChangeFailureTitle (:38). MgStateBanner renders the actions (mg_state_banner.dart:93-96).

initState, the events listener, _load and the empty check (paid_change_banner.dart:34-61) have no v2 branch; MgV2 appears only in _box (:127). The pending state uses MgTone.pending with the same title and text (:105-113). The banner stays silent when there is nothing to show, as in the old look.

res_detail_tab_content.dart:144-147 uses the same pickupAllDayLegacy / pickupHm condition for both looks. ResDetailRow switches only its drawing to ResDetailRowV2 (res_detail_row.dart:24-26), which shows the label and value (res_detail_bits_v2.dart:52-66). The v2 detail uses this same ResDetailTabContent (res_detail_view_v2.dart:97); reservation_detail_screen.dart:162-163 routes v2 there.

hasNavTarget is computed once (res_location_row.dart:59-60). The v2 branch passes onNavigate: hasNavTarget ? _openNavigation : null (:70). ResLocationV2 draws the navigate disc only when onNavigate != null (res_location_v2.dart:55-70). The lat/lng arguments with the branchLat/branchLng fallback are the shared ones at res_detail_tab_content.dart:152-167. Correction to the claim: the file res_sections_v2.dart / resNavigate does not exist. A grep for openNavigation and resNavigate finds no other caller, so the detail row is the only v2 entry point. openPickupMap (core/widgets/pickup_location_link.dart) belongs to the edit and payment screens, not this guard.

typeLabel (deliveryLabel/branchPrefix) and isDelivery are computed at res_location_row.dart:56 and passed to ResLocationV2 (:64-69). v2 shows the truck or pin icon tile (res_location_v2.dart:39) and the text 'typeLabel · address' (:49-52). The information matches the old look.

res_detail_tab_content.dart:175-180 shows ResLateGateV2 only when res.kioskReleasePending (the same condition as the old :181). ctaLabel and onCta are non-null only when res.status=='reserved' (:178-179), and onCta pushes the same '/reservations/<id>/edit'. ResLateGateV2 draws MgBtnInk only when both are non-null (res_detail_parts_v2.dart:96-99). The note text is the same ssLateGateNote with a clock icon. The release 70a94933 had the same rule at :157/:169.

The same row conditions at res_detail_tab_content.dart:214-230 apply in both looks: deliveryFee>0, extrasPrice>0, latePickupDiscount>0, discountAmount>0. ResDetailRowV2 keeps valueColor (greenDarker) and the minus sign in the value (res_detail_bits_v2.dart:59-65).

res_modification_history.dart:50 hands off to ResHistoryV2 from res_history_v2.dart, the non-collapsed one imported at :8. The collapsed ResHistoryV2 in res_docs_v2.dart is not imported anywhere, so it is dead code. The hasDateMod/_datesChanged rule is the same (res_history_v2.dart:28-36), and so is ModDescription.describe with the title typeText. The original and new term rows are kept (:62-80). Minor cosmetic difference: the old card colours are blue for extended, red for shortened and amber for moved; v2 uses green ok, amber warn and grey info. The heading text ('Zkráceno o N dní' etc.) is unchanged, so the meaning is still clear.

hasCancellation = displayStatus==cancelled (res_history_v2.dart:39). _cancellation (:83-103) mirrors the old _buildCancellationCard (res_modification_history.dart:637-673) row by row with the same conditions: cancelledAt!=null, cancelledBy always, reason non-empty, stornoFee>0, refundAmount>0, and the same admin/system/customer source mapping. The section heading uses a calendarX icon in err colour instead of the emoji.

hasSos is the same (res_history_v2.dart:38). The sosIncidents list comes from the same sosIncidentsProvider at res_detail_tab_content.dart:79-80 and is passed through :239. ResHistorySosV2 (res_history_parts_v2.dart:316-398) has the sosReplacement banner (ok tone), endedBySos with the 8-character id (err tone), and per incident the shortId, type, status coloured by resolved/closed, created -> resolved time and title. This matches the old :506-631.

The events and their conditions in res_history_v2.dart:108-118 match the old _buildTimeline (res_modification_history.dart:680-709): created; confirmedAt; issuedAt (res.issuedAt); returnedAt; actualReturnDate only when returnedAt is null; cancelledAt; ratedAt with the rating. The order is also the same. resV2EventRow always returns a widget under v2 (res_fit_v2.dart:30-31), so no row disappears.

hasHistory = modificationHistory.isNotEmpty is the same (res_history_v2.dart:37, 43). _EntryV2 (res_history_parts_v2.dart:122-263) mirrors the old _buildHistoryCard/_buildEntry (res_modification_history.dart:194-371). It keeps the same source mapping and the same kind-label fallback chain (moto, then time, then gear/extras, then place). It keeps the same change rows: date shifts only when the day diff is not 0, moto, pickup/return method, pickup/return address, pickup/return time, gear including own_gear Yes/No, passenger suffix and 'histRemoved'. The extrasChanged signal is kept too. The old card shows no per-entry payment field that v2 drops.
